scenes.text: We present Campus Cubbies: a production service connecting personal agents with U C S C systems.
Before enrolling next quarter, an international student asks their agent: Is there anything I need to know?
Earlier, the International Student Office sent an update about new federal enrollment rules through Campus Cubbies.
Now, their agent catches up, connects the update with their enrollment plans, and helps identify what to ask the office before registration.
No magic here. It's all backed by a new My Cubby folder in your U C S C Google Drive, created for you the first time you connect.
We built around A two A, the Agent to Agent protocol. Different agent harnesses can discover the service, connect, and use the same permissioned tools. They don't need matching interfaces.
The office can contribute without reading your private notes. Cubbies handles permissions and delivery. Your own agent brings the reasoning.
This is active today: campus Google sign-in, your U C S C Drive, and BayLeaf Chat onboarding. We've verified real sign-in, file operations, and authenticated A two A calls.
Campus Cubbies. We connect campus knowledge to your agent, ready when you ask.
